name: sgrna-design
description: Find or design sgRNAs (guide RNAs) for CRISPR experiments using a three-tiered approach: (1) validated sequences from a bundled Addgene database + literature search, (2) precomputed CRISPick designs from the Broad Institute GPP, (3) de-novo design rules. Use whenever someone asks for a guide RNA / sgRNA / CRISPR guide to knock out (KO), activate (CRISPRa), or inhibit (CRISPRi) a gene, mentions SpCas9 / SaCas9 / AsCas12a / enAsCas12a, asks "what guide should I use for <gene>", or wants CRISPR targeting sequences for a screen — even if they don't say "design". Covers human, mouse, rat, and other model organisms. Does NOT run wet-lab validation or genome-wide off-target alignment.
